oe_tr_samarkand_caravanserai = {
	kept_at_conquest = no

	potential = {
		OR = {
			owns = location:samarkand
			owns = location:bukhara
		}
	}

	allow = {
		scope:target = {
			OR = {
				this = location:samarkand
				this = location:bukhara
			}
			NOT = { has_town_rights = town_rights_type:oe_tr_samarkand_caravanserai }
		}
	}

	location_modifier = {
		local_market_access = 0.15
		local_merchant_capacity = 2
		local_silk_output_modifier = 0.20
		local_monthly_prosperity = 0.002
	}

	color = rgb { 128 74 168 }
}
